thesis: The podcast argues that critical minerals are essential for modern technology and industrial growth, yet the industry faces significant challenges due to its bespoke, asset-specific nature and long permitting timelines in the US. It highlights the need for new companies to build vertically integrated, software-first mining and refining operations to address these complexities and meet future demand.
